sources.entry: Price Per Token - Compare LLM API pricing across 300+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 30+ providers.

summary.name: Price Per Token
summary.one_liner: A web comparison table of per-token API prices for 300+ LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Mistral.
use_cases: Comparing API costs across LLM providers
Finding the cheapest model for a given workload
Estimating token spend before choosing a model
Checking context window size alongside price
Tracking LLM price changes over time
summary.what_it_does: The page is a sortable-style table listing LLM models with provider, context window, input price, output price, and cached input price. It also has columns for Coding, MMLU, and GPQA benchmark scores, though many rows show no score. The page states it covers major APIs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Mistral, and shows a "last updated" timestamp. Filter-by-capability and new model release sections are present. The visible text does not show how prices are gathered beyond a claim of official prices.
notable: Lists 300+ models with input, output, and cached input token prices
Includes context window size and Coding, MMLU, GPQA benchmark columns
Shows a last-updated timestamp on the page
caveats: Many rows have missing benchmark scores or cached input prices (shown as dashes)
Page includes a sponsored 'Spot Priced LLM API' promotion that is not part of the comparison data
Pricing shown is per token as listed; the page text does not state the unit or currency beyond dollar signs
